attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 5, `dnaA` to `yidA`, are carried by 92 to 99.9% of genomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 0.5% of calls. The model names 93 to 100% of them, fewest at column 4, `yidB`, 93%.

**The first fork is at `yidX`**, column 6, carried by 70%. Then the `dgo` genes, variable columns 7 to 11, [[galactonate catabolism]], carried by 84 to 88%: the most plastic stretch of the window. Through columns 45 to 52 a branch of 8 shell families runs in 11%, [[fructose transport and aldolases]].

**The model names as many genes on the spine columns as on the others, 90 against 89%, and hesitates less there**, 0.14 against 0.46 bits. It hesitates most at column 45, `yicJ`, a fork column, 1.38 bits.

**The window ends in the `waa` genes**, columns 69 to 79, [[lipopolysaccharide core]]. The last column is `rfaF`, in 12% of genomes.

**Across the window it names 89% of genes**, 0.41 bits on average, perplexity 1.6 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.83 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 94%.

label: dnaA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the dnaA window: 80 columns from dnaA (column 0) in its direction, in all 2,002 genomes of the PanGBank E. coli pangenome; 130,837 calls of the model, each on a genome's real proteins. 1,359 of the 2,002 genomes have all 80 columns on one contig; in the others the window stops earlier, at a contig end.
[T] TERMS: share: genomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of genomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every genome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other genomes (genes inserted upstream push it out, or a contig ends); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.41 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 82,603 calls, named 95%, 0.16 bits; shell 46,278 calls, named 80%, 0.73 bits; cloud 1,956 calls, named 29%, 3.34 bits. Outside an RGP 89,567 calls, named 94%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 41,270 calls, named 78%, 0.83 bits. Columns: 12 spine, 14 fork, 54 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.83 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 94%); 41,270 of the 130,837 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 45 (yicJ, a fork column) 1.38 bits, RGP 39%; column 44 (setC, a fork column) 1.09 bits, RGP 46%; column 46 (yicI, a fork column) 0.94 bits, RGP 51%. The 18 columns (columns 6-11, 18-23, 46 and 73-77) where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.35 bits on average; the other 61 columns: named 90%, 0.43 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 11 spine columns: named 90%, 0.14 bits on average; the 68 fork and variable columns: named 89%, 0.46 bits. The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 45, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 6-11 (fork and variable columns), RGP 90-99.9%; the least: columns 0-5 (spine), RGP 0-0.5%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of genomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-5 (6 columns) spine: share 92-99.9%, all P, RGP 0-0.5%. Genes: dnaA "chromosomal replication initiator p…", dnaN, recF, gyrB, yidB "YidB family protein", yidA "sugar-phosphatase". named 93-100% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (yidB), named 93%, 0.43 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 6-11 (6 columns) fork and variable columns: share 70-88%, all S, RGP 90-99.9%. named 72-99% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 6, named 72%; most hesitant at column 11, 0.41 bits.
[S2.c6]    6 fork: yidX S 70% "protein YidX"; also "hypothetical protein" S 25%
[S2.c7-11]    columns 7-11 variable, share 84-88%, all S: dgoR 88%, dgoK 85%, dgoA 87%, dgoD "galactonate dehydratase" 86%, dgoT 84%
[S3] 3. columns 12-17 (6 columns) spine: share 95-97%, all P, RGP 0.1-0.4%. Genes: cbrA, yidR "DUF3748 domain-containing protein", yidQ "YceK/YidQ family lipoprotein", ibpA "small heat shock chaperone IbpA", ibpB, yidE "putative transporter". named 27-99% (mean 84%), fewest named at column 16 (ibpB), named 27%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 12 (cbrA)).
[S4] 4. columns 18-79 (62 columns) fork and variable columns: share 9-89%, 47 P, 15 S, RGP 0.2-99.7%. named 67-99% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 75, named 67%; most hesitant at column 45, 1.38 bits.
